correctness.rationale: For every integer \(2\le a\le b\) and all \(c,d>0\), the weighted rook Laplacian has three explicit orthogonal nonconstant eigenspaces with eigenvalues \(ac\), \(bd\), and \(ac+bd\). Taking two edge differences gives strictly positive same-direction coefficients and exactly \(2(b-1)\), respectively \(2(a-1)\), constant-magnitude transverse entries; exact sums yield \(R_A\) and \(R_B\). A strict AM–GM inequality yields the unique maximum \(c/d=b/a\); \(R_A-R_B=2(b-a)(\kappa-1/(ab))\) establishes two thresholds for \(a<b\). The actual verify.py produced 39,265 exact Fraction assertions over 55 configurations, but the universal proof is analytical.

value.rationale: The natural least-squares edge-gradient operator is Hilbert-contracting but can amplify uniformly bounded edge errors by an unbounded factor \(\sqrt{b/2}\) under optimally weighted \(K_2\mathbin{\square}K_b\) designs. The exact all-conductance formula, unique tuning ratio and two direction switches identify the mechanism, while constant weights give a uniform bound below 4. This is a nontrivial full-parameter stability classification rather than a small-table recomputation.
